title: Celebration of Our Reunion
paragraphs: “Sadeena, who’s the person next to you?”
Sadeena turns to her Father and asks.
“You must be Raphtalia.”
“This is Naofumi—the Shield Hero.”
“Huh? The Shield… Hero?”
“That’s right.”
“So you’re Raphtalia. I’m Naofumi Iwatani, the Shield Hero. It’s a pleasure to meet you. I look forward to getting to know you.”
“Rifana… she really wanted to meet you. The Shield…”
“Yeah… I know you went through a really tough time. You held up so well. You were truly admirable. From now on, I won’t let anyone hurt you anymore…”
My Father is speaking gently to Big Sister. She was staring at him with a distant look in her eyes.
“Just rest peacefully for now. It’ll be okay… No one will ever hurt Raphtalia-chan again…”
“Naofumi and the others put an end to the waves. Raphtalia, let’s live together in this village again, okay?”
“Yes…”

Big Sister nodded, gazed at her older sister, and then lay quietly resting in bed. After that, her older sister spoke gently to her about various things. Before long, perhaps because she was still exhausted, Big Sister began to breathe softly in her sleep.
“……She’ll probably be hungry when she wakes up next, so I’d better prepare some food so she can regain her strength little by little.”
“That’s true……”

Big Sister’s older sister held her hand very gently so that she could sleep peacefully. By the way, Big Sister’s older sister is a Beastman so that she can understand more easily. I wonder if there’s a reason for that?
“Looks like she’s asleep.”
“It certainly seems that way.”
Ren, Itsuki, and the Rival—who’d decided on their own that they were getting in the way—have returned.
“I’m so glad you’re alive, Sadeena.”
“Yes… I guess miracles really do happen.”
Before long, my Big Sister’s Big Sister smiled cheerfully at Father, and then said:
“I want to drink to celebrate my reunion with Raphtalia!”
Ren and Itsuki slumped their shoulders in exasperation.
“You use just about anything as an excuse to drink, don’t you?”
“Seriously… you’re such a mood killer, Naofumi.”

“Ahaha… that’s so typical of you, Sadeena. But I think I understand how you feel. After all, you were so depressed and thought Raphtalia was dead, and now you’ve been reunited with her. Of course you want to celebrate.”
“Yes! So, Naofumi-chan. There’s something else we need to think about now.”
My Big Sister’s older sister started rubbing her stomach.
“Since we’ve been reunited with Raphtalia, if this baby is a girl, what should we name her?”
“Ah… yeah, that’s true.”
“What do you mean, Naofumi-san? Were you planning to name a girl born to Sadeena ‘Raphtalia’?”
“I can understand that.”
It seems my Father and my Big Sister’s older sister had planned to name the unborn child after my Big Sister.
“Well, yeah. Sadeena and I had discussed it and decided on it.”
“What would you have done if it had been a boy?”
“Sadeena had already decided on a name for that too.”
“Well, we can just decide on a new name later. Actually, it might be a good idea to ask Motoyasu or Gaelion. That is, if there’s a parallel world where Naofumi and Sadeena have a child.”
“There is. But I think it would be tacky to reveal that.”
Is that the name of your Father’s and your Big Sister’s child? What was it again? I’m not even sure what your Father and your Big Sister’s child is named.
“It’s not like you can just say, ‘Oh, I’ll ask Motoyasu or Gaelion.’ We’ll figure that out as we go. We still have time… and we’ve even met Raphtalia.”
“So, Naofumi. You’re going to raise this child and invite them to the Feast of Carnal Desire, aren’t you? Since she’s the one destined for it, you’ll do it, right?”
“Oh my…”
At this point, Itsuki asks Father.
“Itsuki… you’re still the same as ever. If you don’t shape up, I’m going to rip those ‘Bald Head’ headphones right off your head and use Fleon-chan’s sonic waves to awaken you to justice.”
Oh no! He’s threatening Itsuki with the same killing intent he uses when scolding Kou.
“This is no joke! There are things you can and can’t say!”
“You’re the one who said it, Itsuki! You’re in no position to say that, especially after you got mad at Motoyasu-kun for telling you ‘For You’ about losing your virginity to Rishia-san!”
“To even think of making a move on such a young girl…” Father is utterly dismayed.
“In the first place, there’s no way I’d ever make a move on the younger sister of someone I’m in love with.”
“But there’s the example of Imiya… It might only be a matter of time before Raphtalia develops feelings for Naofumi. Shouldn’t you be prepared for that?”
“Ugh…”

My father turned his gaze toward her Big Sister, as if seeking a lifeline. It’s true that he isn’t the type to make a move on a child. In fact, even in the first world where he ended up with her Big Sister, it took a long time for them to become a couple. My former self was actually surprised that my Father and my Big Sister weren’t in that kind of relationship. In other words, it’s a rare occurrence for my Father to end up with someone like my Big Sister or the Tiger Girl. That said, in this world, because my Big Sister’s older sister is involved, he seems unable to trust his own instincts.
“Ugh…”
“It’s okay. I certainly wouldn’t go so far as to ask Raphtalia-chan out.”
“Yeah, you know, even with the ‘Shield Hero’ bonus, please stick to the ‘step-sister’ route, okay?”

It seems even my Big Sister’s Big Sister wouldn’t drag my current Big Sister into this. That said, if my Big Sister were as pushy as she was in the first world, who knows? Well, I don’t really know what my Big Sister is like in this world, though.
“Step-sister, you say… Motoyasu, don’t you have something to say?”
“Father, if she’s my stepsister, that would mean we’d be in a romantic relationship!”
“Well, I know Motoyasu-kun’s past is like that, but… don’t you think it’s a bit much to make a move on your sister-in-law when you’re already married to her older sister?”
Is that so? Back in the day, I got along just fine with those twin pigs, didn’t I? And there were as many pigs calling themselves my sisters as there are stars in the sky.

Still, my father-in-law’s sense of chastity is truly unshakable. The Tiger Girl from the First World who broke through that must be quite the character. That said, I think my father-in-law in the First World still had some sense of propriety.
“Itsuki, if you don’t tone down your teasing of my father-in-law, I’ll get angry.”
“Motoyasu is the last person I want to hear that from. You have no idea how much trouble this is causing me…”
She’s even brushing off my intimidation. Wouldn’t it be better to just wake Fleon-chan up to her sense of justice already, so we can have some peace and quiet?
“Ren, you get it, right?”
“Don’t bring that up with me. We don’t have to follow the First World’s example. That’s all there is to it—what kind of logic is it to force us to copy them?!”
Oh, Ren’s coming to my Father’s defense. But is it just my imagination, or does Ren from the first world look a little sad when he hears these words?
“Well, Ren is single, sure… but there’s no progress with Wyndia-chan, and nothing with Eclair-san either… yeah. You don’t have to follow the first world exactly.”
“In Ren’s case, he says Black Thunder is just a friend and doesn’t want to be his lover. Having a lover adds some spice to life, you know.”
By the way, Itsuki is technically taking care of Riska. She’s regained quite a bit of her energy, hasn’t she? We plan to gradually enhance Riska based on our knowledge.
“Shut up! Be quiet! The First World isn’t the be-all and end-all!”
On the other hand, Ren isn’t really involved with his Assistant or Éclair, is he? Wouldn’t it be better for him to have fun with Black Thunder, who is, after all, his destined Filolial-sama?
“I… no, never mind.”
“When you get defiant like that, you end up summoning Black Thunder, don’t you? You sounded like you were about to say something like ‘I like being alone,’ ‘I love solitude,’ or ‘I’m a loner.’”
“What am I supposed to do…? Next time, I’ll charge in carrying a bouquet just to get rejected by Eclair. That’s the way to go. It’ll be so uncool.”
“I think Eclair-san would be in trouble if she got dragged into that…”
“Big sis doesn’t have the Sword Hero on her radar either… I need to find a new, decent romantic partner!”
And so, Ren was sitting alone, lost in his twilight musings.
“Ugh… uuugh…”
“Oops, Rafu’s starting to have a nightmare. Naofumi and Sadeena, make sure to take good care of her.”
Come to think of it, the Big Sister I met in the next loop used to cry out in pain at night, didn’t she? It seems those symptoms are coming back.
“Isn’t it because we were making a racket here?”
“I can’t exactly deny that, so everyone, please散会.”
“Oh my—”
Anyway, the Big Sister had returned to the village like this.

About a week has passed since then. The village has almost completely recovered. Thanks to the devoted care of her Father and her older sister, the older woman is gradually regaining her strength. It was on a day like that.
“Spear Hero—!”
My Rival came running toward me with the same enthusiasm I’d seen before.
“What is it, Rival? I’m busy here.”

I’m helping Yuki-chan with her running training in the village. After all, word of Yuki-chan’s achievements hasn’t spread far and wide yet. Yuki-chan loves to run, so I’m having her enter more and more races to show off her speed. Of course, she’s been a star in every loop so far.
“Yuki-chan! How about I be your sparring partner in Drive Mode?”
I suggest to Yuki-chan that we run side-by-side—just like she enjoyed doing in the loop where she reunited with Fleon-chan.
“N-no, thank you, Motoyasu-sama!　Just having you watch over me, Motoyasu-sama, gives me the strength of a hundred men!”
Oh? Yuki-chan turned me down. Maybe we’ll do it someday?
“That’s right. Yuki also finds some things hard to accept. I get it now.”
“What exactly do you understand?”
“I have a bad feeling about this!”
Exactly! Rival! What are you plotting?!
“This is a good story. Just listen to me. You should remember this—we did it before.”
With that, my Rival pulls out a strand of hair. This scenario sounds familiar.
“Is that Big Sister’s hair again? Will my Father in this world be pleased?”

When I made a Raph-species from Big Sister’s hair and presented it to my Father in the world where I reunited with Fleon-chan, he really liked it—but will my Father in this world be pleased? To begin with, there are no bio-plants here, so I’ll have to make it using substitute plants. That raises the difficulty a bit. I’ll give it some thought, at least. Come to think of it, there was a time in the next world when my Father picked up the Raph-species that my Big Sister from the first world had transformed into. He said it was a cute monster, so I have a feeling he’ll like it.

“I don’t think he’ll be as happy as Naofumi was, but you should make one for him anyway. Honestly, my guardian spirit wants this, but I don’t really understand why. Is it something to do with ancestral blood or something?”
“Motoyasu-sama! I have a feeling you shouldn’t listen to that!”
Yuki-chan’s point is valid, I suppose. I don’t quite understand what my Rival is saying!

“Is that so? Come to think of it, Yuki, aren’t you interested in flying or anything like that? If you get the Spear Hero to modify you while he’s at it, you’ll be able to fly. That’s what Filo wanted.”
“Yuki loves running! I have no interest in the sky whatsoever!”
“Yuki never changes, no matter where she is. Maybe you should ask Sakura next time.”
“What do you plan to do to Sakura-chan?!”
“You know full well, yet you’re asking. You’re the only one who’d do that.”
“Ah, there she is! Over here! Hah… hah… hah…”
Just as we were having this exchange, a young-looking Big Sister came over with my Father and my sister’s older sister. My Big Sister looks rather flustered, doesn’t she?
“Wait, Raphtalia-chan.”
“Oh?”
My Father came over and stared at me and my Rival.
“Gaelion-chan, I heard this from Raphtalia-chan…”

“Well, you see. This kid was rummaging around behind me a moment ago, picked something up, and ran off shouting, ‘I got Rafu’s hair!’ So I hurried to report it to the Shield Hero and Sadeena-nee-san.”

Hiding behind her Big Sister, she explained the situation. Wow! That’s just like her! Her analysis of the situation and immediate response are superb! In a situation like this, calling my Father over was absolutely the right move. The Big Sister from the loop where she first reunited with Fleon-chan didn’t even notice, though.
